symbols: swimlane: LR/nonLR body/title geometry, title measurement, width floor, label transforms, rough paths

interface: overlay_swimlane_groups(painter,layout,commands)->tuple[Paint,...]; called by Painter.finish only for mermaid-swimlane

dataContract.group_data: tuple of frozen Mapping; source complete groups, including synthetic lane, final global center x/y,width,height,parentId,label,padding,swimlaneContentTop,direction/look/colorIndex
dataContract.identity: GraphLayout.groups remains input parents; group_data additionally contains source synthetic DefaultLane
dataContract.LR: Final source centers and frame widths/heights already rotated/recomputed by provider. direction remains LR, source ignores contentTop; title x=left+(labelHeight+8)/2, y=groupCenterY, text origin=(cx-labelHeight/2,cy+labelWidth/2), rotation=-90
dataContract.otherDirections: TB/BT/RL use source nonLR top band min(labelHeight,max(0,contentTop-laneTop))
dataContract.DefaultLane: Created only by source prepare when parentless nonGroup nodes exist; id __swimlane_default__, empty label,padding20, next source color slot, requested look/direction. Overlay never synthesizes its own lane or suppresses the source empty-label frame.

sourceImplemented: Top-level source lane title/body rectangles and rotated/nonrotated labels
Reuse original same-ID title TextBox/rich measured runs and frame ResolvedStyle/palette; synthetic/no-title commands actually measure the source label
Remove only original same-ID frame/title by semantic role or real cluster paint context; preserve nodes, edges, nested groups and unrelated commands
Prepend real generated lane paints before all original retained content; no node/edge repaint
Native rough source .7 roughness/title fillWeight3 branch, palette gate and source CSS classes
Actual Painter path/text ink participates in finish bounds and budgets; no canvas-only inflation
Ancestor display/opacity applies new lane children; existing rich run opacity preserved relatively
Isolated temporary Painter command buffer restored in finally; owner-thread native state never serialized
threadOwnership: Painter owner-thread only; input/output immutable pure command/geometry values
units: Final geometry is logical CSS px and degrees; no engine/drawing coordinate translation recomputed
remainingVerification: Independent source TB/BT/RL/LR, nested parent + loose DefaultLane functional captures
Exact old-command removal: preserve all unrelated same-ID edge roles and all nested groups
Rich label/palette/title hiding/custom style scope, empty-label and long-label width floors
Rough ink extents and source frame overlap/readability against actual nodes/routes
No P1 behavior or rendering PASS inferred; full candidate stays source-unverified
limits: Only top-level groups are replaced; nested groups intentionally keep source ordinary group paint
Original premeasured rich title runs stay intact; no flattening to plain label or guessed label language
No changes to A12 frozen family products, GraphLayout/provider or other shared files
